messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: High 5xx rate detected on dedicated pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3. 5xx rate=12.4% over the last 3m (alert threshold 1.0%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Triggered at 2026-03-15T10:12:01Z.
Maya: Oncall grabbing this. starting quick triage — checking autoscaling, recent deploys, and pool health.
Maya: metrics dashboard: backend error logs show OOM/connection timeouts on nvx-worker-12..16. CPU/GPU util high ~ 98% on those nodes.
Sanjay: No deploys in the last hour from releases channel. Likely traffic surge + model mem pressure. I'm going to check Dedicated pool scaling policy.
Trent: Any customers on burst that could be spiking? We should consider enabling burst capacity or temporarily raising max_replicas.
Lia: From support: three customers opened errors within the last 6m — acme-corp, shoply, messagepro. All using the large-context model variant (gptx-epoch-32).
Maya: Reproducing logs: repeated KV cache misses causing GPU mem growth, resulting in worker restarts. Autorestart loop visible.
Sanjay: Plan proposal: 1) enable emergency burst capacity on eu-west-1-dedicated-3, 2) temporarily increase max_replicas from 24 -> 48, 3) add ingress throttle for the heaviest customers if needed. Any objections?
Trent: +1 on burst. Need to be careful about cost but customer impact is more important. If burst doesn't stabilize, we'll set per-customer rate limits.
Maya: Doing burst toggle now.
Maya: ```
# enable emergency burst
rictl pools update --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 --set emergency_burst.enabled=true --set emergency_burst.size=20
```
deploy-bot: PATCH /internal/pools/eu-west-1-dedicated-3 returned 202. config change queued. change_id=chg_20260315_001
deploy-bot: rollout status: change_id=chg_20260315_001 -> applied to control-plane nodes.
Sanjay: While that's applying, I'm going to increase max replicas.
Sanjay: ```
rictl pools update --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 --set autoscaling.max_replicas=48
```
deploy-bot: PATCH accepted for autoscaling.max_replicas, update applied.
Maya: Observability: within 90s of enabling burst + scaling, GPU util on affected workers dropped to ~65%, worker restarts stopped. 5xx rate trending down.
Maya: Current 5xx rate=3.1% (was 12.4%). Still above baseline but improving.
Lia: Noting customer impact: ACME still seeing timeouts in dashboard but errors reduced. Support will notify them that we're mitigating and may apply targeted rate limits if needed.
Trent: Let's prepare a short-lived quota override to protect the pool if another surge hits. Proposal: apply soft limit to heavy accounts (acme-corp, shoply) reducing concurrency by 30% for 10 minutes.
Maya: I can apply that. Command below.
Maya: ```
# apply temporary quota override
rictl quotas override --account acme-corp --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 --concurrency-multiplier 0.7 --expires-in 10m
rictl quotas override --account shoply --pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 --concurrency-multiplier 0.7 --expires-in 10m
```
deploy-bot: quota overrides created: ov_789 (acme-corp), ov_790 (shoply).
Sanjay: After quota override, burst still active, scaling at 42/48 replicas. 5xx down to 1.2% now. Good.
Maya: I'm going to start an on-call handoff—I've got a meeting in ~20m. Trent, can you own the incident for the next 40 minutes and watch for recurrence?
Trent: Taking it. Thanks Maya — summary: enabled emergency burst (size 20), bumped max_replicas to 48, applied temporary per-customer concurrency multipliers for acme & shoply for 10m. Current status: 5xx=1.2%, latency slightly elevated but stable.
Lia: Support note drafted to customers: "We observed transient errors on dedicated pool eu-west-1-dedicated-3 due to a traffic surge. We enabled emergency burst and scaled the pool; you may see reduced concurrency for 10 minutes while we monitor. Please reach out if you continue to see issues." Shall I send?
Trent: Send it. Also request ACME to hold heavy batch jobs if they have any.
Maya: Handing off logs/commands in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incident/1769954321 — includes command history and metrics snapshot.
Trent: I'll keep the mitigations in place for 30m and then evaluate rollback cadence. If 5xx stays <1.0% for 15m, we can remove quota overrides and disable emergency burst (or reduce it).
Sanjay: Suggestion for follow-up: add autoscaling policy tweak — prefer faster scale-up with shorter cool-down for dedicated pools running large-context models. I'll open an infra task.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll join if anything escalates.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: status changed -> mitigated (partial). 5xx rate decreased to 1.2%. Incident metrics archived to incident/1769954321.
Trent: Closing notes: continue monitoring, if we see another surge we'll consider enabling cross-region fallback and more aggressive customer throttles. Handoff complete — I'm primary.
